records.text: A Romanian viewer alleges that the 1989 Romanian Revolution was orchestrated from outside the country and that outside actors pushed George Soros into Romania as it ended.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep DdPjoy5W-wY)

appearances.snippet: Here in my country, we all know now that this was not our revolution. It was actually orchestrated from the outside by those globalist Illuminati who pushed George Soros into Romania right as the revolution ended.

verification.notes: Historical scholarship discusses foreign interest and competing theories around the 1989 revolution, but current reliable evidence does not establish that outsiders orchestrated it or that George Soros was specifically pushed into Romania as alleged. The causal allegation remains unproven.

sources.title: Diplomacy & Statecraft: British policy and the Romanian revolution
sources.relevance: Historical scholarship reviews external involvement and finds limited direct evidence for a foreign-orchestrated revolution; it does not substantiate the specific Soros allegation.
